subject: Change approval chronology & CI handoff for release-2027.07
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@fintechco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: security-assess@fintechco.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: change approval chronology & artefact handover (release 2027.07)

Hi Karthik,

As part of our SIG review we need a compact chronology for the July release (labelled release-2027.07) showing: PR approvals (who approved, timestamps), CI/CD run ids and logs for the successful deploy, artifact handover evidence (what build artifact was promoted), and any key/secret rotation that occurred around the change window.

Can you provide a package that includes: PR review logs, CI run stdout (or link), the change ticket with approvals, and a short note on whether any secrets were temporarily exposed to non-production runners and how they were remediated? We need this by EOD Wednesday (Aug 2).

Thanks — Alice
Alice Monroe
Senior Security Engineer, FinTechCo
security-assess@fintechco.com

Attachment: none
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@fintechco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: change approval chronology & artefact handover (release 2027.07)

Alice — thanks for the clear ask. We'll pull together the chronology and the artifacts you listed. Quick clarifying items so we deliver exactly what you need:

- Do you want raw CI logs for all matrix jobs, or only the deploy pipeline and the failing job traces?
- We'll include PR metadata (approver, timestamp, review comments). Do you need the full commits (diffs) or a redacted commit list?

Plan: Monica will collect the PR/merge timeline and CI run details; Marissa will pull the change ticket and approval PDF; I'll export the KMS rotation summary and confirm which keys rotated in the 72-hour window.

We'll aim to deliver a single archive and include a doc (readme.txt) that maps each file to your evidence checklist.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer | Director, Platform Security | Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@fintechco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: change approval chronology & artefact handover (release 2027.07)

Hi Alice — forwarding the bundle below. I've pulled the artifacts into a secure share and attached the key files to this thread. Brief notes inline.

--- Attached files (summary) ---
1) pr-review-log-20270720.csv — CSV with PR id, author, approver, approval_ts, merge_ts.
2) ci-run-8472-stdout.log — deploy pipeline stdout for job 8472 (successful).
3) change-ticket-INC-2984.pdf — internal change ticket with approvers and timestamps.
4) kms-rotation-summary-202707.pdf — export from KMS showing rotation events around 2027-07-20 to 2027-07-22.
5) redacted-commit-list.txt — list of commits promoted (contents redacted per legal).

Key observations:
- The PR merged at 2027-07-20T14:03:22Z; approver was Marissa Cole (approval comment included in CSV).
- CI job 8472 shows artifact produced: build-20270720-6f2a9 (sha-prefix included in redacted-commit-list).
- No plaintext secrets were written to CI logs; a small number of runners had temporary plugin telemetry enabled — we rotated ephemeral runner tokens within 2 hours and the KMS summary shows the rotation event at 2027-07-20T16:07:00Z.

Links: Drive bundle — https://drive.redwood.company/drive/folders/1a2B-deploy-evidence-2027
HubSpot ticket: HB-4729 (internal mapping to change INC-2984).

Let me know if you need unredacted commits under an NDA; we can produce them via a secure transfer.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Engineering Manager, Release Engineering | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: pr-review-log-20270720.csv (text/csv); ci-run-8472-stdout.log (text/plain); change-ticket-INC-2984.pdf (application/pdf); kms-rotation-summary-202707.pdf (application/pdf); redacted-commit-list.txt (text/plain)
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@fintechco.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: security-assess@fintechco.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: change approval chronology & artefact handover (release 2027.07)

Monica — this is exactly what we needed, thank you. A couple quick follow-ups:

- Please confirm that redacted-commit-list.txt contains only commit SHAs and filenames (no diffs).
- For audit completeness can you provide the deploy pipeline's parameter invocation (the variables passed at runtime) — if any variables are secrets please redact the values and indicate which variables were redacted.

If you can send those two items before EOD today that's perfect.

Best,
Alice

Attachment: none
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@fintechco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: change approval chronology & artefact handover (release 2027.07)

Alice — quick update to close the loop.

- redacted-commit-list.txt contains commit SHAs (7-char prefixes) and top-level filenames only. No diffs, no code snippets.
- Attached ci-run-8472-params.txt (included in the Drive bundle) — it is a parameter dump with secret values replaced by <REDACTED>. The variable names are visible and we annotated which ones are secret in the readme.
- The archive also includes an internal readme (readme-evidence-20270720.txt) mapping each file to the SIG checklist item.

If you require the unredacted commit diffs for a legal review, please share a signed NDA link and I'll coordinate secure transfer.

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the SIG schedule.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer | Director, Platform Security | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: ci-run-8472-params.txt (text/plain); readme-evidence-20270720.txt (text/plain)
